packageRules.description: Never update this repo's own image. docker-compose.yml must keep tracking the latest tag.

description: Automerge base image updates. pinDigest is the first pin, digest is every bump after.
Do not add minimumReleaseAge. A digest update carries no timestamp, so it would be held pending and never merge.
Never automerge GitHub Action updates. Actions run with the Docker Hub token and the GITHUB_TOKEN, so a person must review every one.
Do not replace this with minimumReleaseAge. It ages from a version's first release, not from a tag re-push, so a force-pushed tag clears the delay at once.
Keep the trailing comments at the major tag, such as # v7. An exact version like # v7.0.1 turns these into patch and minor updates, which another rule could automerge.
